items.title: Revert To Pre-2016 For True ‘Abolition’ Of Contract Doctor System

items.title: Mandate Mediation For Medical Negligence Complaints Before Lawsuits, Says APHM
items.summary: APHM's Dr Kuljit Singh wants medical negligence disputes to undergo mandatory mediation before suing.
